sloka: रावणे सुख सम्विष्टे ताः स्त्रियो विविध प्रभाः ।ज्वलन्तः कान्चना दीपाः प्रेक्षन्त अनिमिषा इव ॥५-९-६७॥
transliteration: rāvaṇe sukha samviṣṭe tāḥ striyo vividha prabhāḥ ।jvalantaḥ kāncanā dīpāḥ prekṣanta animiṣā iva ॥5-9-67॥

translations.english: When Ravana was happily asleep, the gods of light burning on the gold lampposts gazed without winking as it were, at the women, whom they dare not gaze for fear of waking Ravana.
